scientific_question: Can the exact 200.07x global rank-150 interleaved TT family represent the terminal sparse-MoE c_fc function when its nonlinear cores are optimized jointly on routed function across two activation banks, rather than selected by endpoint weight-energy TT-SVD?

same_gauge_diagnosis.finding: At a fixed mapping endpoint, changing activation banks leaves only 6.4-6.8% of gradient energy in a global rank-7 subspace; changing the fitted endpoint at fixed data leaves about 0.07%. The needed chart is nonlinear and must be judged in function space.

endpoint_tt_rejection.finding: Randomized endpoint TT-SVD recovers only about 0.0044 routed function. Its sealed scope explicitly does not reject functional optimization of the same nonlinear TT coordinates.

causal_reconciliation.why_not_blockfht: Fixed BlockFHT directions, learned spectra, a learned shared butterfly, fully unshared one-sweep butterflies, and static rank-7 tangent templates all failed. This candidate changes both direction learning and curvature: every TT core is learned through routed functional loss and the materialized matrix is multilinear in the compact coordinates.
causal_reconciliation.why_not_lora: No dense base or learned dense basis is retained. TT bond rank constrains the complete layer/expert/hidden/input tensor but does not impose low ordinary rank on an expert matrix.
causal_reconciliation.mapping_paper_boundary: The candidate is a nonlinear compact latent-to-weight map optimized by task-aligned functional loss. Paper-style perturbation stability, smoothness, alignment, and modulation are deferred until representability passes; adding them cannot repair a failed function family.

source.terminal_gauge: Use terminal routing, dense target c_fc, and exact terminal dense expert c_proj. Dense V/O and c_proj remain explicit residual-write exceptions.

mechanism.parameterization: Initialize by the registered seeded interleaved endpoint TT-SVD, sweep left-to-right QR while pushing every R into the next core, then optimize raw cores through differentiable reduced-QR left-canonicalization of every core except the last. The last core carries global amplitude. This removes scalar gauge blow-up and fixes the local canonical chart while preserving the full TT family.

initialization.selection: Both fixed seeds are fit and reported; no seed selection.

fit_protocol.optimizer: AdamW on compact TT cores only
fit_protocol.task_schedule: Cycle deterministically through the six registered bank-layer tasks; each optimizer step uses all eight experts for one task.
fit_protocol.objective: Equal-expert mean normalized exact-dense-c_proj residual-output MSE plus 0.25 times normalized pre-GELU MSE.
fit_protocol.selection: Final registered optimizer step only; heldout banks never affect fitting, stopping, hyperparameters, or seed selection.

evaluation.controls: Score the same seed's unoptimized canonical TT-SVD initialization on every heldout bank and layer. Functional-fit gain is candidate minus its own initialization.
metrics: fit objective trajectory and relative decrease
functional-fit gain over the exact initialization
same-heldout action cosine between fitted seeds
maximum CUDA memory and wall time

decision_rule.pass: Passing every fit, heldout, gain, agreement, and finiteness gate for both seeds and both heldout banks authorizes only production TT c_fc implementation and a separately preregistered initialization plus Mapping-Loss shadow. It does not authorize language-model training.
decision_rule.representability_fail: Reject the exact left-canonical, jointly function-fit global rank-150 TT route. Do not sweep rank, modes, seed, fit steps, LR, objective weights, thresholds, or canonicalization without a new residual theory.
decision_rule.optimization_fail: If the objective does not decrease with finite gradients, classify conditioning separately from representability and permit only a zero-update optimizer-geometry audit; do not infer function-family failure.
decision_rule.systems: Run an exact-shape five-step preflight. Foreground-poll only if projected total runtime is below five minutes; otherwise use one terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog with the active-note continuation prompt.
